Customs Act 1969: The Government exercises its authority under section 18(2) of this Act to amend previous statutory notifications regarding customs duties and taxes.
S.R.O. 219-AIN/2017: This existing notification is further amended through the current SRO.
TABLE-II: This table replaces the previous version within the specified notification and defines the Regulatory Duty (RD) rates applicable to a variety of specified H.S. Codes.
H.S. Code: The H.S. Codes listed in the table identify the specific goods subject to modified Regulatory Duty rates.
